control_failures.control_label: control of freeboard, beach width and decant

hazard_media: stored potential of an elevated component
facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: near hit - gravity exposure at CV-3101

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 1 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control EMBANKMENT_SURVEILLANCE: the surveillance of embankments and instrumentation was not in place, and the accident investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.

Control IMPOUNDMENT_FREEBOARD_CONTROL: the control of freeboard, beach width and decant was in place but did not perform, and the accident investigation classified this as a task or environmental condition.

recommendations: Restore the surveillance of embankments and instrumentation on CV-3101 and record the spot check before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in governing the impoundment, specifically performing dam-safety review and surveillance. CV-3101 (plant conveyors) is in service for coarse ore and reclaim conveying. The task proceeded during shift handover while the surveillance of embankments and instrumentation was not in place. The gravity energy involved is held as suspended load, and the recorded presentation was fall, collapse, crush.
response.summary: On 7 July 2007 a near hit was recorded on CV-3101 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility during shift handover; gravity energy held as suspended load was not released.
